title: The ticket plan approves a proofs-only build
intention: A proofs-only build whose ticket plan names the proof file reads as approved by the plan itself, and the tester never opens an approval question in Akien's inbox.
why: Akien, F50 in ~/.cairn/foreground-decisions.md (2026-10-09), verbatim: 'tester should never ask me about anything that i don't need to have approved. the plan based tickets are inherently preapproved.' Under f5bba1daa72a (ruling 8p, 2026-10-06) a proofs-only build reads 'measured nothing' at PROVEME unless an answered question names the file, and --seal opens that question itself; 68e897fc74b8 and 017d8298662a would each put one in his inbox.
traces_to: Law 9 (Akien's head outranks the older translation, ruling 8p) and Akien's review bandwidth (his inbox is for vision coherence only); Akien, F50 in ~/.cairn/foreground-decisions.md (2026-10-09), verbatim: 'tester should never ask me about anything that i don't need to have approved. the plan based tickets are inherently preapproved.'
how: In cairn/devices/tester/hollow.py, approval() reads the ticket's plan (the flat tickets/<id>-<slug>.json, which is the plan once 76da3a283277 and task 29569fca68a3 land: its writes_to, how and falsifier-named paths) and returns 'plan' when every skipped file is named there; cli.py's --seal stops calling ask_for_approval, and ask_for_approval retires. The standing approval proof is rewritten to F50.
falsifier: Done when, in a fixture commons through the tester's public CLI: (1) a proofs-only build whose ticket plan names the proof file reads green at --hollow and records the approval as the plan (no question id), and --seal opens NO question; (2) a proofs-only build that writes a proof file its plan does NOT name stays red ('measured nothing') and opens no question either — the red is the record; (3) a non-proofs-only empty run stays red as now. The standing proof cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_the_tester_records_an_approved_proofs_only_build.py is rewritten to these clauses (its question-based approval retires with ruling 8p). Wrong intent if: a plan cannot name its proof files in a field the tester can read without parsing prose (then this waits on the plan/log format ticket).
workflow_and_state: code-seam@v2: THINKME -> TICKETME -> [FIXME:waiting] -> BUILDME -> PROVEME -> PROVED
watchme: none, because the measure is the questions corpus itself: CairnCommons/questions/ gains no question raised_by the tester after this ships
builder_notes: WHERE: cairn/devices/tester/hollow.py approval() :715 and ask_for_approval() :735; cairn/devices/tester/cli.py:160 (the --seal call). Build only after the plan/log format ticket lands: read the plan file's named proof paths through the ticket store's reader (never parse prose). approval() returns 'plan' when every skipped instrument file is named; the finding's approved map records {file: 'plan'}; ask_for_approval and the cli.py:160 call are removed. Rewrite cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_the_tester_records_an_approved_proofs_only_build.py to clauses (1)-(3), fixture commons under scratch_dir, PROVES keyed to this ticket; keep test_the_hollow_skips_only_the_instrument.py tooth 3 (instrument-only, plan does not name it -> red).

decisions.text: The plan is the flat tickets/<id>-<slug>.json (Akien 2026-10-10: 'Flat plan + .log.jsonl'); there is no plan.json. The proof file is 'named by the plan' when its path appears in the plan's writes_to, how or falsifier. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09.

The plan names a file when the file's repo-relative path is an element of the ticket's top-level writes_to list; how and falsifier prose are not parsed (the falsifier's own 'without parsing prose' narrows the HOW). CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09
decisions.step: unlisted: what 'the plan names the file' means

decisions.text: harbor_master clearance.py hollow_lacks (~:740-760) is in scope: an approval reading {'approved': 'plan'} holds only when the ticket's writes_to is a list containing that file, else hollow_approval_unresolved; older question-id approvals are still re-read through _approval_holds. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09

cli.py --seal stops calling ask_for_approval and the function retires; a proofs-only build whose file the plan does not name stays red 'measured nothing' and opens no question — the red is the record. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09

hollow.measure already loads the ticket as a dict (hollow.py:767, via _ticket_path); approval() is handed that dict and reads its top-level writes_to list there. No new reader is built. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09

This ticket's builder makes both edits: the tester's (hollow.py, cli.py) and harbor_master's (clearance.py hollow_lacks, which already receives the ticket dict as its first argument at clearance.py:645). No other ticket carries the clearance change. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09

decisions.text: Measured 2026-10-11: 76da3a283277 and 29569fca68a3 are both PROVED, so every ticket is a plan file in CairnCommons/tickets/ whose top-level keys are the store charter's plan_fields, and writes_to is one of them; hollow.measure reads ticket.get('writes_to') from that plan, absent meaning an empty list. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09

Measured 2026-10-11: hollow.py:767 in measure() is ticket = json.loads(_ticket_path(ticket_id, commons).read_text(...)), the plan as a dict, before any file is measured; approval is handed that dict from there and never re-reads the ticket. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09

approval(ticket, files) takes the ticket dict measure() already loaded and returns the string 'plan' when ticket.get('writes_to') is a list and every path in files is an element of it (string equality, repo-relative posix); otherwise None. In measure(), a non-None result sets approved = {f: 'plan' for f in only}; None leaves approved empty and the run red 'measured nothing'. The finding no longer carries approval_wanted. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09

A file is 'named by the plan' exactly when its repo-relative path string is an element of the ticket's top-level writes_to list (D2); how and falsifier text are never searched. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09

Nothing replaces it: cli.py --seal keeps sealing each finding['approved'] file as {'approved': <value>} (now 'plan'), deletes the approval_wanted block that called hollow.ask_for_approval, and hollow.ask_for_approval and ASKER are deleted from hollow.py. No question is opened on any path. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09

decisions.text: clearance.py hollow_lacks (~:749-760): a reading {'approved': 'plan'} is unresolved unless ticket.get('writes_to') is a list containing that file; any other approved value is re-read through _approval_holds(tid, qid, question_root) as today. Unresolved files yield hollow_approval_unresolved naming them, exactly as now. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09
